attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "New Elasticsearch/AzureAI index handler and JSON converter changes touch core (de)serialization of index metadata used across all tenants' search indexes, so a subtle bug (e.g., property order, null handling in ElasticsearchIndexMetadataConverter) could silently corrupt or fail to round-trip existing index profiles."}

reason: New Elasticsearch/AzureAI index handler and JSON converter changes touch core (de)serialization of index metadata used across all tenants' search indexes, so a subtle bug (e.g., property order, null handling in ElasticsearchIndexMetadataConverter) could silently corrupt or fail to round-trip existing index profiles.
